## Controller Metrics

Metric families declared by the `agent-sandbox-controller` for its metrics endpoint. The Go
runtime, process, and `controller-runtime` metrics that every controller-runtime manager exposes
are not listed here.

| Metric | Type | Help | Labels |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_sandbox_build_info` | Gauge | Agent sandbox controller build metadata exposed as labels with a constant value of 1. | `build_date`, `compiler`, `git_commit`, `git_version`, `go_version`, `platform` |
| `agent_sandbox_claim_controller_startup_latency_ms` | Histogram | Latency from the controller first observing the SandboxClaim to the claim reaching Ready in milliseconds. | `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandbox_claim_creation_total` | Counter | Total number of Sandboxes created or adopted for a SandboxClaim. | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `launch_type`, `warmpool_name`, `pod_condition`, `created_by` |
| `agent_sandbox_claim_startup_latency_ms` | Histogram | End-to-end latency from a mutating admission webhook first observing the SandboxClaim (the agents.x-k8s.io/webhook-first-observed-at annotation) to the claim reaching Ready in milliseconds. Note: Only recorded for claims carrying that annotation. | `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandbox_client_claim_startup_latency_ms` | Histogram | End-to-end latency from the client-recorded request time (the agents.x-k8s.io/client-first-requested-at annotation) to the claim reaching Ready in milliseconds. Note: Only recorded for claims carrying that annotation, and may be affected by clock skew between the client and controller. | `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandbox_creation_latency_ms` | Histogram | Latency from Sandbox creation to the Sandbox Ready condition in milliseconds. Note: For warm launches the Sandbox is created by the SandboxWarmPool, so this measures the pool's provisioning time; a claim may adopt the Sandbox before or after it becomes Ready. | `namespace`, `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandboxes` | Gauge | Monitor the point-in-time number of sandboxes in the cluster. | `namespace`, `ready_condition`, `expired`, `launch_type`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by`, `created_by` |
